sql_err_governance_hint.message: The query spent more units than NetSuite allows. Tighten the filters, cut JOINs or select fewer columns.

sql_err_timelimit_title.message: The query took longer than allowed

sql_err_timelimit_hint.message: Filter on indexed fields (the id, or a date), drop columns from the SELECT or narrow the range. Large tables without a filter will not finish in time.

sql_err_notqueryable_title.message: That record cannot be queried through SuiteQL

sql_err_notqueryable_hint.message: "$1" is not exposed to SuiteQL, or the feature that enables it is turned off on the account (Setup › Company › Enable Features).

sql_err_permission_hint.message: Your role cannot read those records. Ask an administrator, or try a role that has read permission.

sql_err_alias_hint.message: "$1" is used twice as a column name. Every alias in the SELECT has to be unique.

sql_err_ambiguous_hint.message: "$1" exists in more than one of the joined tables. Prefix it with the alias you mean: t.$1.

sql_err_groupby_title.message: Those columns need to be grouped

sql_err_groupby_hint.message: When mixing SUM, COUNT or AVG with plain columns, EVERY non-aggregated column must appear in the GROUP BY.

sql_err_join_title.message: That JOIN does not exist in the model

sql_err_join_hint.message: The two tables have no direct relationship in NetSuite. Check the records catalog for the linking field, or go through an intermediate table.

sql_err_identifier_hint.message: "$1" is not a field on that table. If the query has a JOIN, it may just be missing its alias in front. Check the name in the records catalog.

sql_err_table_hint.message: Check the name in the records catalog. Some tables only exist when the matching feature is enabled on the account.

sql_err_typearg_title.message: The parameter type does not match

sql_err_typearg_hint.message: The value passed does not match the column type: convert it first (number against number, date against date).

sql_err_queryarg_hint.message: The operator doesn't exist for that column type, or two columns are being compared where NetSuite only allows comparing against a value. Change the operator or move the comparison into the WHERE.

sql_err_pagesize_title.message: The page size is out of range

sql_err_pagesize_hint.message: NetSuite only accepts pages of between 5 and 1000 rows. Set the page size within that range.

sql_err_params_title.message: There is an invalid parameter in the query

sql_err_params_hint.message: The parameter list carries something NetSuite won't take: an empty value, an object or a nested list. Only plain values can be passed (text, number, date or boolean).

sql_err_memory_title.message: The result doesn't fit in memory

sql_err_memory_hint.message: The query returns too much data at once for the script's memory limit. Fetch it in pages, filter further or ask for fewer columns.

sql_err_ora_hint.message: $1 comes from the database underneath NetSuite, not from SuiteQL. It's usually a type conversion that doesn't add up (text being read as a number or a date), a division by zero, or an Oracle function SuiteQL won't allow.

sql_err_parsefail_hint.message: NetSuite rejected the query and won't say why. Check the table and field names, and that no quote or parenthesis is left unclosed.

sql_err_paging_hint.message: The page cursor expired or the query changed. Run it again to start over.

sql_err_syntax_hint.message: Usually one comma too many or too few, an unclosed parenthesis or quote, or a misspelled keyword.

sql_err_engine_title.message: The search engine rejected the query

sql_err_engine_hint.message: NetSuite gives no further detail. It usually clears up by simplifying: drop subqueries, cut JOINs or split the query in two.

sql_err_unexpected_hint.message: NetSuite hides the cause and only leaves an ID. The failure is almost always in the query: a column or table name that doesn't exist, a misaimed JOIN, or an unsupported function. Check them against the records catalog. If it all checks out, keep the Error ID $1 for Support.

cl_6_2_0_ai_nofreeze_title.message: The assistant no longer leaves the tab unresponsive

cl_6_2_0_ai_nofreeze_desc.message: While it fetched data the page stayed up but stopped responding to clicks, and the browser's "page unresponsive" warning could appear. You can now keep using NetSuite while the assistant works, and it only pulls the data it needs instead of far more than it will use.

cl_6_2_0_ai_progress_title.message: The assistant no longer looks stuck while it works

cl_6_2_0_ai_progress_desc.message: Even with the work history turned off, you now see what it is doing and which step it is on, out of how many. Before there were only three dots, and a long wait felt like it had frozen.

cl_6_2_0_ai_continue_title.message: You can tell it to keep going when it runs out of steps

cl_6_2_0_ai_continue_desc.message: If the assistant uses up its allowed steps without finishing, a button appears to continue, and it picks up right where it was with everything it had already worked out; you can raise the step count right there too. Before you had to ask again and it redid the whole thing from scratch. It also starts out with more steps available now.

cl_6_2_0_recent_shared_title.message: Recent records: you also see the shared account's activity

cl_6_2_0_recent_shared_desc.message: The list now mixes your own visits from this machine with the account's recent activity, ordered by actual time. If you share an account, whatever someone else just opened shows up at the top instead of being buried at the bottom — no need to turn the feature off to see it.

sql_rows_confirm_body.message: $FETCHED$ rows of $TOTAL$ so far. Fetching the rest may take a while.

sql_rows_confirm_body_unknown.message: $FETCHED$ rows so far and NetSuite says there are more. Fetching the rest may take a while.

sql_rows_capped_max.message: Fetched $FETCHED$ of $TOTAL$ rows: that is the maximum set in preferences.

sql_rows_capped_guard.message: Fetched $FETCHED$ of $TOTAL$ rows: the download stopped as a safeguard.

sql_rows_capped_limit.message: Fetched $FETCHED$ of $TOTAL$ rows: NetSuite stopped the download at its execution limit.

sql_rows_capped_user.message: Fetched $FETCHED$ of $TOTAL$ rows: the execution was stopped before finishing, so the results are incomplete.

sql_rows_capped_user_unknown.message: Fetched $FETCHED$ rows and the results are incomplete: the execution was stopped before finishing.

cl_6_2_0_prodpos_title.message: Choose where the production warning shows

cl_6_2_0_prodpos_desc.message: Besides the bottom bar, it can now sit in a top bar or as a badge in the header, in the same spot where NetSuite shows the sandbox logo. You pick it from the popup and the change shows immediately, no reload needed.

sql_run_timeout.message: The query never answered; you can try again.

cl_6_2_0_sql_logs_resize_title.message: Split the log the way you like

cl_6_2_0_sql_logs_resize_desc.message: A divider between the list and the detail lets you drag the width of each side, and it remembers how you left it for next time.

cl_6_2_0_sql_progress_title.message: You can see what a long query is doing

cl_6_2_0_sql_progress_desc.message: While it runs, the editor dims and a notice over the results keeps you posted: the rows being fetched, and when the table is being prepared. It used to just say "Executing", so a big query looked frozen.

cl_6_3_0_sql_busy_title.message: The Runner stays usable while the query runs

cl_6_3_0_sql_busy_desc.message: Fixed the SuiteQL Runner running notice covering the whole panel and leaving the log and the previous results unreadable.

cl_6_3_0_sql_stop_title.message: You can stop a running query

cl_6_3_0_sql_stop_desc.message: Added a button to stop the SuiteQL Runner query while it runs, keeping the rows fetched up to that point.

sql_stop_title.message: Stop the query and keep the rows fetched so far

sql_status_stopping_page.message: Stopping… finishing the page in progress

sql_logs_mark_unexpected.message: Line $1, column $2 — parsing stopped here, at "$3"

cl_6_2_0_sql_logs_ai_title.message: Runner errors now explain themselves, and AI can fix them

cl_6_2_0_sql_logs_ai_desc.message: The log no longer dumps NetSuite's raw error: it says what went wrong in one sentence, points at the failing line and column on the query itself, and keeps the technical text folded away in case you need it. For the common mistakes it offers the fix with a button to apply it and run, and "Fix with AI" works the fix out right there, showing a before/after comparison and a button to apply it and run. The list filters by text or error code and splits into failed and successful runs.

sql_chart_export_title.message: Download the chart as an image

sql_chart_export_empty.message: There is no chart to download

sql_chart_copy_na.message: There are no rows to copy in the chart view

sql_err_permission_title.message: Your role cannot read that data

sql_fix_trailing_comma.message: There is one comma too many right before FROM.

sql_ai_fix_unavailable.message: The AI assistant is turned off.

sql_logs_clear_confirm.message: Clear the whole log? This also clears the query history, which is where the earlier entries come from.

cl_6_2_0_sql_status_title.message: The Runner tells you how the query is doing

cl_6_2_0_sql_status_desc.message: The results panel now says so from the first moment: "Executing…" with the elapsed seconds, then rows and time when it finishes. While it runs, the previous results dim so they can't be mistaken for the new ones.

cl_6_2_0_sql_logs_title.message: New Logs tab in the Runner

cl_6_2_0_sql_logs_desc.message: Next to Results there is now a tab with everything that has happened. If a query fails, the panel jumps there on its own and shows the full error, the exact query behind it, and buttons to copy either one or load it back in the editor. The error used to go through a one-line notice that was easy to miss.

sql_logs_pick.message: Pick an entry to see its detail.

cl_6_2_0_sublist_pin_title.message: The line number stays pinned too

cl_6_2_0_sublist_pin_desc.message: With both "Sublist line numbers" and "Fixed sublist column" enabled, scrolling a sublist sideways now keeps both columns in view: the line number, which tells you which row you are on, and the first column. The number used to end up hidden behind it.

settingsResetDesc.message: Leaves the extension as if freshly installed. A backup is downloaded first.

settingsResetConfirmBody.message: Everything the extension stores — preferences, themes, saved queries, history and tab groups — will be erased and reset to its defaults, as if you had just installed it. A copy of your current settings is downloaded first so you can come back with Import.

settingsEnableAllDatedDesc.message: Turns $1 preferences back on from the backup taken on $2.

bulkRestoreConfirmBodyDated.message: $1 preferences from the backup taken on $2 will be turned back on. The backup is then cleared.

bulkImportBackupNote.message: A copy of your current settings will be downloaded first, in case you want to go back.

cl_6_2_0_bulk_confirm_title.message: Confirmation before enabling or disabling everything

cl_6_2_0_bulk_confirm_desc.message: Enable all, disable all, restoring your backup and importing settings now tell you how many preferences will change before applying it, and any bulk change can be undone from the message that appears afterwards. Importing also downloads a copy of your current settings first, in case you want to go back.

cl_6_2_0_bulk_restore_title.message: "Restore preferences" can no longer wipe your setup

cl_6_2_0_bulk_restore_desc.message: Previously, with no backup saved, that button turned every preference on and swept away the ones you had deliberately switched off. It now only restores the backup saved when you disable them all: with no backup it changes nothing, the button tells you what date the backup is from and how many preferences it holds, and the backup is used once so an old selection can never be re-applied later.

bulkDisableConfirmBody.message: $1 preferences will be turned off. A backup is saved so you can restore them later.

bulkRestoreConfirmBody.message: $1 preferences from the backup saved the last time you disabled everything will be turned back on. The backup is then cleared.

toastRestoreNoSnapshot.message: There is no saved backup to restore

settingsEnableAllEmptyDesc.message: No backup saved yet. One is created when you disable every preference.

cl_thanks.message: Thanks to everyone who reports bugs and suggests improvements. Every one is read — write from the envelope ✉ button in the popup, or under Settings → Feedback.

cl_2_3_0_export_search_tabs_desc.message: The Export Search modal now shows SuiteScript 2.x and SuiteScript 1.0 as top tabs, with the Copy and Send to Console buttons aligned with the tabs. No more scrolling to discover the 1.0 version.

cl_2_3_0_row_id_copy_desc.message: Custom record field sublists now include a copy button on each row's ID column, to copy the scriptid directly. Honors Shift (SuiteScript snippet) and Alt (JSON key) modifiers.

cl_2_3_0_refresh_sublist_desc.message: New module: adds a Refresh button on the toolbar of each recmach sublist to reload only that sublist without performing a full page reload.

cl_2_3_0_full_logs_desc.message: New module: on the script execution page (script.nl) adds a button to the right of Live Mode that opens the full log archive (scriptnotearchive.nl) with filters ready: all dates and sorted by timestamp descending.

cl_2_3_0_code_prettier_title.message: Code Fields Prettier: XML and HTML support

cl_2_3_0_code_prettier_desc.message: The code field formatter now also detects and formats XML and HTML (in addition to JSON and SQL), with indentation and syntax highlighting.

cl_2_3_0_log_prettier_title.message: Log Prettier: XML and HTML support

cl_2_3_0_log_prettier_desc.message: The execution log cell formatter now also detects and renders XML and HTML content (in addition to JSON and SQL), with syntax highlighting and copy buttons.

cl_2_2_1_delete_order_desc.message: Fix: the Delete button now always appears immediately after the Save & Edit / Edit & Save button, regardless of which module loads first.

cl_2_2_0_report_bug_desc.message: New button in the popup header that opens a form to report bugs found in the extension.

cl_2_2_0_feature_request_desc.message: New button in the popup header that opens a form to suggest new features or improvements.

cl_2_1_0_split_title.message: Record Options split into 5 independent modules

cl_2_1_0_split_desc.message: The Record Options module was split into 5 independent toggles in the popup: Save and Edit, Edit and Save, Delete Record, Cancel without History.Back, and Options Menu. Each feature can now be enabled or disabled individually.

cl_2_1_0_startup_freeze_desc.message: The service worker now filters out non-NetSuite tab events and caches preferences in memory. Eliminates the 20–30 second browser lockup when restoring sessions with many open tabs.

cl_2_0_0_json_formatter_desc.message: Renders raw JSON from Suitelets and RESTlets as a collapsible, searchable tree with copy, download and multiple themes. Persists the selected theme in storage.

cl_2_0_0_advanced_pdf_desc.message: Three new modules for Advanced PDF/HTML Templates: tag autocomplete, live preview pane and version history listing.

cl_2_0_0_csv_viewer_desc.message: In the CSV Import response page, opens the response file as an editable table using Papa Parse for quick inspection and editing.

cl_2_0_0_discreet_desc.message: Hides account numbers and unrelated account links in the account switch menu to keep screenshots and screen shares clean.

cl_2_0_0_load_n_desc.message: Loads any SuiteScript 2.x N/* module into the current tab's console from the right-side menu for quick exploration.

cl_2_0_0_quick_search_desc.message: Record type selector with diacritic-insensitive search plus favorite shortcuts shown on the New Saved Search wizard.

cl_2_0_0_role_finder_desc.message: Adds a search box to the account/role switch menu so you can filter roles by name.

cl_2_0_0_script_upload_desc.message: On the Script record page, a file upload shortcut that replaces the active script file without manual navigation.

cl_2_0_0_in_search_preview_desc.message: Preview record details in-line from saved search results without leaving the results page.

cl_2_0_0_wf_colored_desc.message: Colors workflow transition arrows with selectable palettes, line style (solid/dashed/dotted) and adjustable width.

cl_2_0_0_wf_searcher_desc.message: Crawls workflows and builds a searchable index of states, transitions and actions for quick lookup.

cl_2_0_0_open_custrec_desc.message: New button next to Copy Sublist ID that runs SuiteQL to locate the owning Custom Record and opens its edit page in a new tab.

cl_2_0_0_autogen_prefix_desc.message: Set a default prefix (e.g. 'cb') so new fields/records are named _cb_name instead of _name. Live preview in the popup.

cl_2_0_0_cmd_palette_expansion_desc.message: Added Transactions section (Sales Orders, Invoices, Vendor Bills, Credit Memos, Journals, Work Orders, Item Fulfillments/Receipts, BOM, Weekly Time) and expanded Setup & Admin (Users, Subsidiaries, Departments, Chart of Accounts, Fiscal/Tax Periods, Currencies, Import Assistant, Sandbox Accounts, Enable Features, and more).

cl_2_0_0_suitelet_fab_desc.message: New draggable floating capsule as a fallback when NetSuite's native action bar is not available. Remembers its position between sessions.

cl_2_0_0_popup_rework_desc.message: Options are grouped into category tabs (Featured, Records, Dev, Search, Layout, Productivity, PDF, Workflow) with new icons and consistent styling to make features easier to find.

cl_2_0_0_popup_reorder_desc.message: Featured section now lists Color Themes, Grouped Tabs, Command Palette and Env Badge in that order.

cl_2_0_0_cmd_palette_urls_desc.message: Fixed several broken shortcuts (Custom Records, Script Deployments, Custom Segments, Vendors, Set Preferences, Company Information) and removed entries that no longer exist.

cl_2_0_0_xss_audit_desc.message: Broad review of modules that render NetSuite data (field values, error messages, record names) to prevent HTML injection from unexpected content.

cl_2_0_0_perf_desc.message: NSFT modules now share internal listeners instead of each one watching the page independently, reducing CPU usage on large NetSuite pages.

cl_2_0_0_resilience_desc.message: Internal mechanism added so features keep working when NetSuite changes its DOM. Releases should now break fewer modules.

cl_2_0_0_stability_desc.message: Eliminated benign console errors that appeared when closing grouped tabs or interacting with custom Suitelets.

cl_1_0_1_desc.message: Added "Open List" and "Open Record" icons for select and list fields.

cl_1_0_1_desc_scripted_records.message: Fixed an issue where the Client and Workflow tabs appeared blank after a refresh in the View Scripted Record modal.

cl_1_0_2_desc_themes.message: Additional improvements to NetSuite Color Themes covering sublists and dashboard portlets.

cl_1_0_2_desc_tabs.message: Improved automatic grouping to bypass browser UI bugs and clean up ghost groups.

cl_1_0_3_desc_editor_tab_close.message: Improved close-on-save behavior for the code editor when opened in a tab, matching native popup behavior.

cl_1_0_3_desc_set_field_values_txn.message: Set Field Values now resolves and opens transaction custom fields for custbody, custentity, and custitem using SuiteQL with scraping fallback.

cl_1_0_3_desc_record_options_edit_save_l.message: In Record Options, the Edit & Save button now correctly shows the Saving... state while running.

cl_1_2_1_colorthemes_desc.message: Color Themes hotfix: the main menu (Transactions, Lists, Reports...) no longer breaks when NetSuite renames its uif* classes on each release. We now use stable selectors based on ARIA attributes (role="menuitem", data-widget="MenuItem", data-highlighted) that NetSuite must keep for accessibility.

cl_1_2_0_auto_code_theme_desc.message: Code syntax themes (Record Object viewer and SuiteQL Runner) now switch automatically when toggling light/dark mode: Atom One Dark/Light and Dracula/Eclipse — unless the user has already picked one manually.

cl_1_2_0_cmd_palette_desc.message: Searchable VS Code-style palette (Ctrl+Shift+Space) with 45+ actions: quick navigation to lists, current-page actions (XML, copy URL, switch Edit/View) and NSFT tools. Fuzzy search, recents and user-configurable shortcut.

cl_1_2_0_copy_snippet_desc.message: When copying a field or sublist ID: plain Click copies the ID; Shift+Click copies the SuiteScript snippet record.getValue({ fieldId: 'x' }); Alt+Click copies the JSON key "x": "".

cl_1_2_0_copy_snippet_title.message: Copy IDs as SuiteScript snippet or JSON

cl_1_2_0_dark_mode_desc.message: Real dark mode in the popup and 7 modals (Record Object, Scripted Record, SuiteQL Runner, Command Palette, Find Field, Export Search, Search Fields, Set Field Values). Auto / Light / Dark toggle in the popup header.

cl_1_2_0_env_badge_desc.message: Environment badge on the extension icon: PRD (red), SB# (green), RP (blue), TD (purple) and DEV (orange). Per-tab, updates on navigation and exposes the full environment name as a tooltip.

cl_1_2_0_log_filter_desc.message: Level filter chips in execution logs: DEBUG, AUDIT, ERROR, EMERGENCY, SYSTEM — with live counters and distinctive colors per level.

cl_1_2_0_memleak_desc.message: Log Live Mode and Auto Refresh now stop their setInterval/setTimeout when the module is disabled from the popup. Prevents memory leaks and phantom reloads.

cl_1_2_0_popup_desc.message: Popup fully redesigned with category chip filters, global option search, sticky category headers and a blue accent stripe to visually separate categories.

cl_1_2_0_sfv_templates_desc.message: Field value templates: capture the editable values of the current record, save them under a name and apply them to other records from the Command Palette.

cl_1_2_0_sql_fav_hist_desc.message: New ★ Favorites button on the toolbar, unified with the existing Save/Open system. "Recent" section with the last 30 executed queries and relative time (now, 5m, 2h). Click to open in a new tab.

cl_1_2_0_sql_tabs_desc.message: Multiple open queries in tabs with cross-session persistence, unsaved-change indicator ●, + button to create new tabs and × to close them.

cl_1_2_0_sr_counters_desc.message: Counters in the Scripted Record modal tabs (User, Client, Workflows) and All / Active / Inactive filter chips for quick navigation.

cmdp_act_sfv_apply_desc.message: Restore field values from a saved template

cmdp_act_sfv_save_desc.message: Snapshot the current form values for later replay

cmdp_act_nsft_turbo_desc.message: Strip NetSuite animations for snappier navigation

cmdp_act_nsft_askai_desc.message: Opens an AI chat over this page with the current record's context

enableAiAssistantDesc.message: An assistant that answers your questions about the record you're viewing and your NetSuite account, in plain language and without leaving the page.

sqlai_model_reset_title.message: Restores the provider's suggested model list (keeps the ones you added)

cmdp_splitsearch_disabled.message: Enable "Saved search split view" in NSFT settings

pp_unavailable.message: Timing data is not available on this page.

cmdp_act_page_copy_rec_url_desc.message: Shareable link that opens this exact record

welcomeWizProfileTitle.message: Where do you want to start?

welcomeWizProfileSub.message: Pick a starting point. With Custom you choose category by category, and you can change it any time from the settings.

welcomeWizProfileNoneDesc.message: NetSuite stays as it is and you turn on what you need.

welcomeWizProfileSuggestedDesc.message: The useful ones on, with nothing that affects performance.

welcomeWizProfileAllDesc.message: Every NSFT feature enabled, the whole extension.

colorThemesScopeNote.message: Applies to every NetSuite account and any role, and always on top of the native themes.

welcomeWizProfileCustomDesc.message: You pick, category by category, what gets turned on and what does not.

welcomeWizSkip.message: Skip and keep what I picked

welcomeWizDoneSub.message: $1 of $2 features are enabled. You can change them any time from the settings.

welcomeWizDoneMore.message: Many features also have their own settings — theme, interval, colors — that you can fine-tune any time from the popup, right under its switch.

settingsWizardDesc.message: Review which features you have on, category by category.

welcomeTagline.message: A simpler way to work in NetSuite.

welcomeEarlyNoticeBodyPre.message: To avoid conflicts and get the most out of NSFT,

welcomeEarlyNoticeBodyBold.message: we recommend disabling any other NetSuite extension you have installed.

welcomeEarlyNoticeBodyPost.message: See the three quick steps below.

welcomeRedwoodNoticeBodyPre.message: NSFT is now compatible with Redwood, NetSuite's new interface.

welcomeRedwoodNoticeBodyPost.message: — if you spot one, please help us by reporting it through the "Report a bug" button so we can fix it as soon as possible.

showcaseHeading.message: Features you'll probably use every day.

showcaseCard1Desc.message: Full SQL editor with schema explorer, autocomplete and JOIN wizard — right inside NetSuite.

showcaseCard2Desc.message: Inspect the raw JSON of any record with a full in-page viewer — no extra API calls needed.

showcaseCard3Desc.message: See every user event, client and workflow script attached to the record you're on, with deploy info.

showcaseCard4Desc.message: All your NetSuite tabs grouped by account and environment — never edit in the wrong place again.

showcaseCard5Desc.message: Hover any field or sublist and copy its internal ID with one click — no more digging through the DOM.

welcomeChallengeBody.message: If you'd like to see NSFT at its best, give it a few days without other extensions active. It helps avoid conflicts and gives you a clearer picture of the full workflow.

welcomeChallengePromise.message: 100+ improvements, one extension. Less noise, more control.

welcomeHowtoStep1.message: Click the Chrome menu (top-right of the browser).

welcomeHowtoStep3.message: Disable any other NetSuite extensions, if you think it's worth a try.

sql_truncated_banner.message: Showing $SHOWN$ of $TOTAL$ rows: that is the maximum you set. You can raise it or tick "fetch every row", up to a ceiling of $CEILING$ rows.

sql_truncated_ceiling.message: Showing $SHOWN$ of $TOTAL$ rows: that is the most that can be fetched, by REST or by N/query. Narrow the query to reach the rest.

sql_truncated_gov.message: Showing $SHOWN$ of $TOTAL$ rows. The run used up the NetSuite execution budget, which is not a setting: raising the maximum will not bring more. Narrow the query, or use the REST method, which does not spend that budget.

sql_truncated_limit.message: Showing $SHOWN$ of $TOTAL$ rows. NetSuite stopped the download at its execution limit, which is not a setting: narrow the query, or use the REST method, which does not spend that budget.

suiteqlFetchAllRowsLabel.message: Fetch every row the query returns

suiteqlFetchAllRowsDesc.message: Ignores the maximum above and brings back everything the query returns. Past 20,000 rows the Runner asks whether to keep going.

suiteqlFetchMethodDesc.message: Both fetch rows 1,000 at a time —NetSuite’s maximum— and both can be paused. They differ in speed, in how far they get, and in what the account needs to have enabled.

suiteqlFetchMethodHint_auto.message:
Uses REST when the account has it; otherwise N/query.
The sensible choice unless you want to force one.

suiteqlFetchMethodHint_rest.message:
Reaches 100,000 rows: it does not burn NetSuite execution units.
The fastest: it asks for several 1,000-row batches at once, and how many is set right below.
Knows the total row count from the start.
Does not freeze the tab —the requests do not block the page— and stopping the query takes effect instantly.
It does not return columns that are empty in every row: it leaves them out. If you name them in the SELECT they come back on their own; with an asterisk you need the box below and the table schema.
Needs REST Web Services enabled and permission on the role.

suiteqlFetchMethodHint_nquery.message:
Only gets as far as NetSuite governance allows: it depends on how many rows and columns the query brings back and on the budget left on the page.
Fetches 1,000 at a time —the maximum—, one batch after another.
Counts the table before starting, so the first wait is longer on big tables.
It brings back EVERY column of the query, including the ones that are empty in every row.
The tab freezes and stutters while it runs, because the query executes in the page itself; stopping is not immediate either: it takes effect once the batch in progress ends.
If NetSuite cuts it off, it hands over the rows it reached and says so.
Works on any account, no extra permissions.

cl_6_4_0_lnm_pick_title.message: Choose which N modules load in the console

cl_6_4_0_lnm_pick_desc.message: Added a picker with every module the page supports, instead of always loading the same thirteen.

cl_6_4_0_es_rename_desc.message: Added the option to change the variable name from the export title, with the code updating as you type.

cl_6_4_0_es_toggles_title.message: Choose what the exported code carries

cl_6_4_0_es_toggles_desc.message: Added two checkboxes to add the column labels and the result loop to the exported code.

cl_6_4_0_es_layout_desc.message: Changed the export: the version is picked at the top, the actions sit at the bottom and only the code scrolls, now numbered.

cl_6_4_0_es_info_title.message: The export says which search it is

cl_6_4_0_es_info_desc.message: Added the search name, its type and how many columns and filters it has at the top of the export.

cl_6_4_0_es_formula_title.message: Formulas no longer break the exported code

cl_6_4_0_es_formula_desc.message: Fixed a column with a formula leaving the exported code unable to run.

cl_6_4_0_es_varname_title.message: The same name in both versions

cl_6_4_0_es_varname_desc.message: Changed the exported code, which named the search differently in SuiteScript 1.0 and 2.x.

cl_6_4_0_lv_toolbar_title.message: Execution Log controls now share one bar

cl_6_4_0_lv_toolbar_desc.message: Changed the look of the controls the extension adds to the Execution Log, which now read as a single bar.

cl_6_4_0_lv_search_title.message: The Execution Log search highlights what it finds

cl_6_4_0_lv_search_desc.message: Added highlighting of matches and a button to clear the search, which now finds words with or without accents.

cl_6_4_0_lv_all_title.message: The Execution Log search focuses on the page

cl_6_4_0_lv_all_desc.message: Removed the button that loaded every script log, replaced by the View Record Logs viewer.

cl_6_4_0_sf_bar_title.message: The sublist filter rests on the table

cl_6_4_0_sf_bar_desc.message: Changed the sublist filter into a strip attached to the table header, showing the rows displayed out of the total.

cl_6_4_0_sf_view_title.message: The sublist filter reaches every sublist

cl_6_4_0_sf_view_desc.message: Added the filter to sublists in view mode and to those with few lines, which used to go without it.

cl_6_4_0_sf_rows_title.message: Sublist buttons stay put while filtering

cl_6_4_0_sf_rows_desc.message: Fixed filtering a sublist hiding its buttons and the total counting rows that are not data.

cl_6_4_0_rs_veil_title.message: The sublist refresh veil matches the theme

cl_6_4_0_rs_veil_desc.message: Fixed the loading veil turning white when refreshing a sublist with dark mode on.

cl_6_4_0_lv_place_title.message: The log search sits in the page button bar

cl_6_4_0_lv_place_desc.message: Changed the search box on the full logs page, which now sits in the button bar instead of loose above the table.

cl_6_4_0_dm_check_title.message: Checkboxes are visible in dark mode

cl_6_4_0_dm_check_desc.message: Fixed record checkboxes showing up white when dark mode is on.

cl_6_4_0_editorclose_title.message: The “Close editor after saving” switch works again

cl_6_4_0_editorclose_desc.message: Fixed that switch in the popup always showing as off, and clicking it saving nothing, even though the feature itself was working.

cl_6_4_0_editortheme_title.message: The editor theme always applies your colors

cl_6_4_0_editortheme_desc.message: Fixed the code editor's Custom theme not applying, theme colors being lost when changing the font or size, and its popup preview showing no colors.

cl_6_4_0_cai_classic_title.message: The account selector gets its badges back in the classic UI

cl_6_4_0_cai_classic_desc.message: Fixed the sandbox badges in the account selector losing their color and number in the classic UI after a NetSuite update.

cl_6_4_0_ct_redwood_title.message: The color theme respects Redwood's white surfaces

cl_6_4_0_ct_redwood_desc.message: Changed the color theme so it no longer tints the bars Redwood shows in white (subtabs, field group titles and list bars); now only the active tab underline follows the theme color, and the classic UI stays colored as always.

cl_6_4_0_ffi_dark_title.message: The found-field highlight stands out in dark mode

cl_6_4_0_ffi_dark_desc.message: Changed the highlight that marks the found field, which sank into the background in dark mode; it now uses lighter, brighter colors.

cl_6_4_0_scrollbars_title.message: The viewers follow dark mode when you scroll too

cl_6_4_0_scrollbars_desc.message: Fixed View Record Object and View Scripted Record keeping light scrollbars with dark mode on.

cl_6_4_0_rom_icon_title.message: The Record Trail icon follows the menu color

cl_6_4_0_rom_icon_desc.message: Fixed the Record Trail icon in the options menu always showing blue, not following the other icons' color or dark mode.

cl_6_4_0_tb_accent_title.message: The extension bars follow the theme color

cl_6_4_0_tb_accent_desc.message: Changed the sublist filter, the pager, the logs bar and the field preview so their backgrounds and accents follow the NetSuite theme color instead of a fixed blue.

cl_6_4_0_sql_offset_title.message: Large Runner downloads no longer stop with an error

cl_6_4_0_sql_offset_desc.message: Fixed some SuiteQL Runner queries failing with a limits error when fetching the last page of results.

cl_6_4_0_fcf_strip_title.message: The format button only shows where there is code

cl_6_4_0_fcf_strip_desc.message: Fixed the empty strip of the SQL/JSON format button lingering under text fields that contain no code.

cl_6_4_0_board_title.message: A public board to follow your reports

cl_6_4_0_board_desc.message: Added a public board to follow bug reports and feature requests from reported to shipped — the link lives in the popup contact menu.

cl_6_4_0_ffi_ui_title.message: The field finder highlights matches and clears in one click

cl_6_4_0_ffi_ui_desc.message: Added match highlighting inside the results and a clear-search button to the find-field-by-ID-or-label finder.

cl_6_4_0_open_mode_title.message: Choose where the record viewers open

cl_6_4_0_open_mode_desc.message: Added the option to choose whether View Record Object and Record Logs open as a floating window or in the browser side panel.

cl_6_4_0_qsc_dark_title.message: Quick search creation follows dark mode

cl_6_4_0_qsc_dark_desc.message: Fixed the quick search creation panel staying light and glaring with dark mode on.

cl_6_4_0_ct_tokens_title.message: All of Redwood follows the theme sliders

cl_6_4_0_ct_tokens_desc.message: Changed the color theme to also recolor Redwood's icons, borders, links and selection states, which kept their factory gray-blue even when moving the sliders.

cl_6_4_0_dm_logo_title.message: The header logo follows dark mode

cl_6_4_0_dm_logo_desc.message: Changed the header logo, which kept its light colours while the rest of the page turned dark.

cl_6_4_0_rlv_desc.message: Added an execution log viewer to the Tools menu, with the current record's scripts preselected and filters by level, script type, detail text and dates. The header lets you switch to another record type — listed by name, not by id — and the script list and the types follow the one you pick.

cl_6_4_0_st_scriptid_title.message: View script opens the right record

cl_6_4_0_st_scriptid_desc.message: Fixed the Suitelet tools' view script option not opening its record depending on how the Suitelet had been invoked.

cl_6_4_0_rr_order_title.message: Recent records land on their date, in order

cl_6_4_0_rr_order_desc.message: Fixed Recent Records placing records from other dates under "Today"; each group now runs from newest to oldest.

cl_6_4_0_ai_panel_title.message: The AI assistant opens in the side panel

cl_6_4_0_ai_panel_desc.message: Opening the assistant on a page now shows the chat in the browser side panel instead of docking onto the page itself: it sits to the side, covering nothing, and still sees the tab you are working on.

cl_6_4_0_ro_panel_title.message: View Record Object, in the side panel

cl_6_4_0_ro_panel_desc.message: A new button in its header docks it to the browser side panel, next to the page instead of floating over it. It replaces the old split-screen mode, which goes away.

cl_6_4_0_ro_sources_desc.message: View Record Object now combines NetSuite’s different query paths and adds the fields that were missing, without touching the ones it already showed.

cl_6_4_0_ro_slide_title.message: The panel slides out of the way

cl_6_4_0_ro_slide_desc.message: Changed the View Record Object panel, which used to appear on the other side at once when moving aside to reveal a field.

cl_6_4_0_ffi_scroll_title.message: Find Field by ID takes you to the field

cl_6_4_0_ffi_scroll_desc.message: Fixed Find Field by ID not scrolling to the field it found; it now opens its tab and glides there.

cl_6_4_0_sfv_pdf_title.message: Field info is back on pages showing a PDF

cl_6_4_0_sfv_pdf_desc.message: Fixed Show Field Information not working on pages that display a PDF.

cl_6_4_0_keystyle_desc.message: Added the option to show shortcuts with ⌘ ⌥ ⇧ or with Ctrl, Alt and Shift, instead of letting the system decide.

cl_4_0_3_rnl_view_only_title.message: Fix: related native links appeared in edit and create mode

cl_4_0_3_rnl_view_only_desc.message: Department, Class, Location and Subsidiary links were also being added when editing or creating a record. They now appear only in view mode.

cl_5_0_0_sql_chart_desc.message: Turn query results into bar, line or pie charts right in the Runner. Pick the X axis (labels) and one or more numeric columns for the values, with optional aggregation (sum, average, count). Toggle between table and chart without re-running the query.

cl_5_0_0_sql_excel_desc.message: The SuiteQL Runner can now export results straight to an Excel file (alongside CSV, JSON and HTML), keeping numbers as numbers.

cl_5_0_0_sql_controls_title.message: SuiteQL: more control over history and limits

cl_5_0_0_sql_controls_desc.message: Choose how many queries the history keeps and how many records a query fetches. Queries that hit NetSuite's usage limit now show a clear, actionable message instead of a generic error, and a banner warns you when a query returned more rows than were shown.

cl_5_0_0_json_tools_title.message: More power in the JSON viewer

cl_5_0_0_json_tools_desc.message: Suitelet and RESTlet responses now decode base64 strings inline on demand, handle line-delimited JSON (JSON Lines), and show responses that are a single value. You can also set how deep the tree opens by default and when large lists start collapsed. The whole viewer is now available in English too.

cl_5_0_0_field_info_desc.message: Hover any field label —custom or standard— to see its ID, type, source list and copy shortcuts without opening its definition. The tooltip appears next to the pointer and follows it as you move. Standard fields now show their correct type when viewing a record too.

cl_5_0_0_account_links_title.message: Quick links between accounts and their reports

cl_5_0_0_account_links_desc.message: In accounting reports the account name now links straight to its record and a new link opens its report; on a record, the department, class, location and subsidiary fields link to their records.

cl_5_0_0_recent_records_title.message: Recent records with full list and search

cl_5_0_0_recent_records_desc.message: Hovering over "Recent records" in the NetSuite header no longer shows just the last 10 entries: you now get the full history with an inline search box, the date each record was opened, and a typed icon per record.

cl_5_0_0_sandbox_num_title.message: Sandbox number visible on the header logo

cl_5_0_0_sandbox_num_desc.message: The SANDBOX (and RELEASE PREVIEW) logo in the Redwood header now shows the environment number (1, 2, …) right after the label so you can tell apart the different sandboxes on the same account at a glance.

cl_5_0_0_open_in_env_title.message: Open the same page in another environment

cl_5_0_0_open_in_env_desc.message: The Tools menu now includes shortcuts to open the current URL in production, sandboxes or release preview, keeping the path and parameters. Useful to jump between accounts without rewriting the subdomain by hand.

cl_5_0_0_schema_export_title.message: Export schema to JSON from the SuiteQL Runner

cl_5_0_0_schema_export_desc.message: The SuiteQL Runner schema explorer now shows a ⬇ button on each table that downloads its definition as JSON. Three modes: full table (fields + joins), fields only, or joins only. Also available via right-click on the table name.

cl_5_0_0_tools_menu_shortcuts_title.message: More shortcuts in the Tools menu

cl_5_0_0_tools_menu_shortcuts_desc.message: The Tools menu in the NetSuite header now also includes Find Field by ID, Command Palette, Keyboard shortcuts cheat sheet and Open in other environment — all discoverable without having to remember the keyboard shortcuts.

cl_5_0_0_cheatsheet_upgrade_title.message: Keyboard cheat sheet with search and wide layout

cl_5_0_0_cheatsheet_upgrade_desc.message: The keyboard shortcuts cheat sheet now includes a filter box at the top to find a shortcut by name, splits into two columns on wide screens to show more without scrolling, and reflects your custom Command Palette key combination instead of the default one.

cl_5_0_0_cheatsheet_extras_title.message: Print and reset actions in the cheat sheet

cl_5_0_0_cheatsheet_extras_desc.message: The keyboard cheat sheet now has a print/Save-as-PDF button to keep an offline copy, and a one-click action to restore default shortcuts in case you changed them.

cl_5_0_0_cheatsheet_interactive_title.message: Try and edit shortcuts directly from the cheat sheet

cl_5_0_0_cheatsheet_interactive_desc.message: Click on a shortcut row to launch its action right away — useful as a quick tour. A new ✎ button next to each customizable shortcut lets you pick a new key combination without leaving the cheat sheet. Find Field by ID and Go to Record are now customizable too.

cl_5_0_0_theme_consistency_title.message: Light/dark theme consistent across every modal

cl_5_0_0_theme_consistency_desc.message: The keyboard shortcuts cheat sheet, the Load Record (SS1/SS2) and Load N Module modals, and the command palette now honour the NSFT theme preference (light / dark / auto) instead of forcing dark just because the operating system is in dark mode.

cl_5_0_0_profile_edit_font_desc.message: The “Edit profile” menu on the header profile button now uses the same typeface as the rest of NetSuite, so it blends in with the interface.

cl_5_0_0_suiteql_position_title.message: SuiteQL Runner keeps its position after minimize

cl_5_0_0_suiteql_position_desc.message: When minimizing and reopening the SuiteQL Runner, the window now returns to the last position you left it, instead of snapping back to the top-left corner.

cl_5_0_0_welcome_redwood_desc.message: The welcome page now states that NSFT is compatible with NetSuite's Redwood interface and asks for help reporting any inconsistencies that may surface.

cl_5_0_0_field_audit_title.message: Field change history inside the ⓘ popup

cl_5_0_0_field_audit_desc.message: The field info popup now has a "Field history" section that loads (on demand) who changed that field on this record, when, the previous value and the new one — all inside the same modal.

cl_5_0_0_sublist_edit_field_desc.message: The field information popup on sublists now shows the button that opens the custom field editor, just like it already did for body fields. Works for both transaction columns and custom record fields living on child sublists.

cl_5_0_0_color_presets_desc.message: A new Preset picker in the Color Themes settings lets you switch between curated palettes (NetSuite Blue, Midnight, GitHub Dark, Slack Aubergine, Forest Green, Crimson, Sunset Orange, Light Mint, Graphite, Royal Purple and High Contrast) in one click. Tweaking the sliders or HEX after picking a preset switches the picker back to Custom.

cl_5_0_0_color_contrast_title.message: Readable text on every color theme

cl_5_0_0_color_contrast_desc.message: When you push the Lightness slider toward the light end, the text on themed headers, sublist tabs and group titles now flips between white and black automatically to stay legible. Light pastels and dark inks are both safe to pick.

cl_5_0_0_color_hex_title.message: HEX input alongside the color sliders

cl_5_0_0_color_hex_desc.message: A new HEX field next to the Hue/Saturation/Lightness sliders accepts a color code (e.g. #3a6196) and applies it directly. Useful when you want to match a brand color exactly without dialing it in by hand. Editing the sliders updates the HEX field, and vice versa.

cl_5_0_0_color_sync_title.message: Color theme follows you across devices

cl_5_0_0_color_sync_desc.message: Your custom Hue/Saturation/Lightness now travel with your Chrome profile, so the theme you picked on one machine shows up on every other machine where you are signed in.

cl_5_0_0_color_primary_btn_title.message: Save and Submit buttons follow your color theme

cl_5_0_0_color_primary_btn_desc.message: The main action buttons on records and forms (Save, Submit and the equivalent primary CTA on every screen) now pick up the theme color along with the headers and tabs, so the whole page reads as a single palette instead of a mix of your color and NetSuite's default. Cancel, Reset and the red Delete button keep their own color so it's still clear which one is the primary action.

cl_5_0_0_gt_user_renames_title.message: Grouped tabs remember your renames and recolors

cl_5_0_0_gt_user_renames_desc.message: If you rename or change the color of a NetSuite tab group from Chrome, NSFT now picks up the change and uses it for the next tab of that account. Before, opening a new tab would create a fresh group with the old name next to your renamed one.

cl_5_0_0_gt_config_polish_desc.message: The Grouped Tabs settings page now validates the subdomain (must be lowercase letters, numbers and dashes), shows in-page error toasts instead of blocking pop-ups, and asks for delete confirmation in a styled modal that matches the rest of NSFT. Existing configs only stored on this device now also follow you to your other Chrome profiles automatically.

cl_5_0_0_gt_rename_aware_title.message: Renamed Grouped Tabs still recognised as your own

cl_5_0_0_gt_rename_aware_desc.message: When you rename an automatic Grouped Tab to anything you like (e.g. "COMPANY PRD" → "Work"), navigating that tab away from NetSuite still ungroups it properly. Before, the renamed group was no longer recognised as one Grouped Tabs created, so the tab stayed stuck in it after leaving NetSuite.

cl_5_0_0_gt_productivity_title.message: Bulk add, presets and import/export in Grouped Tabs settings

cl_5_0_0_gt_productivity_desc.message: A new Tools section on the Grouped Tabs settings page lets you: paste several subdomains at once (one per line, optionally with label and color); apply a one-click preset (Production + Sandbox 1 + Sandbox 2 from a base account ID, plus other combos); export the whole config as a JSON file; and import a JSON either replacing or merging with what you already have. Useful when setting up a new device or sharing a setup with a teammate.

cl_5_0_0_gt_ux_title.message: Drag-to-reorder and auto-collapse in Grouped Tabs

cl_5_0_0_gt_ux_desc.message: Two smaller touches on Grouped Tabs: you can now drag entries on the settings page to reorder them; and an opt-in switch under Automatic Groups collapses inactive groups when you focus a tab (less noise in the tabstrip).

cl_5_0_0_gt_company_name_title.message: Group tabs by company name, not account ID

cl_5_0_0_gt_company_name_desc.message: A new switch under Automatic Groups lets the tab group title show "COMPANY SB1" instead of "1234567_SB1". The company name is reused from the last logged-in session on this device, so login screens that don't render it natively can also benefit. Until the cache is filled, the group keeps the account ID format.

cl_5_0_0_cmdp_templates_robust_desc.message: Saving a field-value template that doesn't fit in synced storage now shows a clear message instead of silently failing. Copy actions in the palette also reuse the same toast style as the rest of NSFT for consistent feedback.

cl_5_0_0_cmdp_visual_polish_title.message: Command Palette: pin your favorites and spot matches at a glance

cl_5_0_0_cmdp_visual_polish_desc.message: The palette got a visual refresh: every entry shows a category icon so the list is easier to scan, the letters of your search are highlighted in matching results (Ctrl+F style), common page actions now display a short one-line description, and you can pin favorite entries with a small button on the right — pinned ones float to the top in their own section, above Recent.

cl_5_0_0_cmdp_smart_filters_title.message: Command Palette: slash filters, context-aware results, Global Search fallback

cl_5_0_0_cmdp_smart_filters_desc.message: Three additions to make the palette feel smarter. Type ">" at the start of your search to pick a category (Navigation, Transactions, Page, NSFT Tools, Pinned, Recent) and filter the list. When you're on a Sales Order, Customer, or any other record type, related actions move to the top automatically. If your query doesn't match anything, the palette offers to run that text through NetSuite Global Search as a last resort — there's also a new "Search NetSuite (Global Search)..." entry you can pick directly.

cl_5_0_0_cmdp_popup_config_title.message: Command Palette: customize the shortcut and add your own URLs

cl_5_0_0_cmdp_popup_config_desc.message: The popup now has a dedicated section under Command Palette where you can change the keyboard shortcut that opens it (click the shortcut box and press a new combination, or hit Reset for the default) and maintain a list of your own URLs. Custom URLs appear in the palette alongside the built-in entries and can also be filtered with the ">user" slash prefix. Up to 30 entries are stored, synced across your devices.

cl_5_0_0_env_badge_colors_title.message: Customizable colors for the Environment Badge

cl_5_0_0_env_badge_colors_desc.message: You can now pick your own colors for Production, Sandbox and Release Preview right from the popup. The badge on the extension icon updates instantly across all your NetSuite tabs and your choice syncs across your devices.

cl_5_0_0_ns_version_click_title.message: Click the NetSuite version badge to copy it

cl_5_0_0_ns_version_click_desc.message: Clicking the version badge in the header copies the full release number to your clipboard — handy when reporting bugs. Ctrl/⌘+Click opens a release-notes search for that version in a new tab.

cl_5_0_0_ns_version_new_desc.message: If the NetSuite version changes between your sessions, an orange dot appears over the version badge until you click it. No more surprises on rollout day.

cl_5_0_0_record_obj_hide_empty_title.message: Record Viewer: hide empty fields with one click

cl_5_0_0_record_obj_hide_empty_desc.message: A checkbox in the Record Viewer modal hides null, empty strings, and empty arrays/objects — great for spotting what actually has a value. By design it doesn't persist: always starts off, you turn it on when you need it.

cl_5_0_0_record_obj_export_title.message: Download the record as a JSON file

cl_5_0_0_record_obj_export_desc.message: A new button in the Record Viewer header generates a `.json` file with the full record, ready to save, share, or attach to a ticket.

cl_5_0_0_record_obj_split_title.message: Split-screen mode for the Record Viewer

cl_5_0_0_record_obj_split_desc.message: A new button docks the Record Viewer to the right of the viewport (resizable by dragging the edge) and shifts the native NetSuite form so they don't overlap. Great for long sessions comparing modal fields against the form.

cl_5_0_0_record_obj_diff_title.message: Highlight of changed fields when reloading the Record Viewer

cl_5_0_0_record_obj_diff_desc.message: When you reload the Record Viewer with the ⟳ button, fields that changed since the modal first opened show an amber stripe and an orange name. Useful for quick QA and audits.

cl_5_0_0_record_obj_stale_title.message: Time-since-load indicator in the Record Viewer

cl_5_0_0_record_obj_stale_desc.message: The Record Viewer footer now shows 'Loaded X min ago' so you know if the data is still fresh. After 5 minutes the indicator turns amber and suggests reloading.

cl_5_0_0_sr_logs_prettify_title.message: Formatted logs in the scripted record viewer

cl_5_0_0_sr_logs_prettify_desc.message: The execution logs panel in "View record scripts" now shows JSON, SQL, XML and HTML entries formatted and colour-highlighted, with one-click copy and download — the same readable view you already get on the script execution log page.

cl_5_0_0_sr_logs_live_title.message: Row numbers and live mode in the scripted record logs

cl_5_0_0_sr_logs_live_desc.message: The execution logs panel in "View record scripts" now has a row-number column (which you can hide from the columns menu) and a live mode button that keeps the list refreshing on its own so you can watch new entries arrive. Live mode starts off and stops when you close the panel.

cl_5_0_0_record_actions_menu_mode_title.message: Choose Button or Menu for the record actions

cl_5_0_0_record_actions_menu_mode_desc.message: Save & Edit, Edit & Save and Delete can now live inside the Record Options menu instead of the button bar. Pick Button or Menu for each one in the popup; in Menu mode the action shows up in the Record Options menu, just before Add Column / Run SuiteQL.

cl_5_0_0_copy_ids_field_info_choice_titl.message: Clearer choices for Copy IDs and Field info

cl_5_0_0_copy_ids_field_info_choice_desc.message: The Copy internal IDs and Show field information preferences now use two clear choices: show the icons, or use the alternative gesture (Shift+click on the field or clicking its label).

cl_5_0_0_record_actions_polish_desc.message: Save & Edit, Edit & Save and Delete now show a spinner while they run so you know the action is in progress. Delete shows a confirmation with the record's type, ID and name, and in Production you can require typing DELETE before it removes anything. Edit & Save can also ask for confirmation before running in Production.

cl_5_0_0_sublist_buttons_polish_title.message: More reliable Refresh sublist and Cancel buttons

cl_5_0_0_sublist_buttons_polish_desc.message: Each sublist's Refresh button now shows a loading indicator while it reloads and warns you if something goes wrong, instead of silently doing nothing. The Cancel button works more reliably on the newer forms and keeps NetSuite's unsaved-changes warning.

cl_5_0_0_editor_toggles_split_title.message: Close editor on save and Open in new tab can now be toggled separately

cl_5_0_0_editor_toggles_split_desc.message: The three file-editor behaviors (theme, close on save, open in new tab) used to share one switch; each one now has its own in the Development panel. If you had the theme enabled, the other two stay on by default.

cl_5_0_0_optimizations_desc.message: Several modules use fewer resources and respond faster: large queries and JSON open and scroll without freezing the tab, Color Themes and the version badge apply almost instantly, the Command Palette types more smoothly, and Grouped Tabs uses less storage and performs better with many windows open.

cl_5_0_0_bugfixes_desc.message: Various fixes: account badges on the classic UI and Test Drive accounts are now identified correctly, several Command Palette entries pointed to the wrong page and it no longer appears on login or error pages, the shortcuts cheatsheet reacts when you turn it off without reloading, and the file editor no longer closes too early on slow saves.

cl_4_1_0_redwood_compat_title.message: Compatibility with NetSuite's new Redwood interface

cl_4_1_0_redwood_compat_desc.message: All NSFT tools now work on NetSuite's new Redwood interface. Buttons, badges, dropdowns, indicators and panels display correctly regardless of whether the environment is running the classic or Redwood UI.

cl_4_0_2_vsr_client_fix_title.message: Fix: the Client tab in View Scripted Record showed no scripts

cl_4_0_2_vsr_client_fix_desc.message: Client scripts attached to a record were not appearing in the Client tab of the View Scripted Record modal. They are listed again. The User Event and Workflows tabs were not affected.

cl_4_0_1_nvb_fix_title.message: Fix: the NetSuite version badge showed up on pages without a header

cl_4_0_1_nvb_fix_desc.message: The badge with the NetSuite version (e.g. 2026.1) was also appearing on secondary screens where there is no NetSuite logo, leaving it dangling. It now only shows up next to the real header logo.

cl_4_0_0_sql_shortcuts_title.message: Keyboard shortcuts in the SuiteQL Runner

cl_4_0_0_sql_shortcuts_desc.message: Ctrl+Enter to run, Ctrl+S to save, Ctrl+Shift+S, Ctrl+O, Ctrl+Shift+F, Ctrl+F, Ctrl+Space, Ctrl+Shift+D, Ctrl+Shift+E, Ctrl+B, Ctrl+Shift+K, Ctrl+Shift+G, Ctrl+Shift+Y, Ctrl+Shift+X, Ctrl+Shift+1, Ctrl+Shift+2. Shortcuts are displayed as pills in the menus and in the toolbar button tooltips. Refresh schema and Toggle Schema Explorer are now also available from the menu bar (Edit / View).

cl_4_0_0_sql_builtin_desc.message: BUILTIN.CF, BUILTIN.DF, BUILTIN.CURRENCY, BUILTIN.CURRENCY_CONVERT, BUILTIN.CONSOLIDATE, BUILTIN.HIERARCHY, BUILTIN.MNFILTER, BUILTIN.NAMED_GROUP, BUILTIN.PERIOD and BUILTIN.RELATIVE_RANGES show up in the same dropdown as tables and reserved keywords (Ctrl+Space), inserting their signature as a placeholder on accept.

cl_4_0_0_sql_tree_fix_title.message: Fix: Schema Explorer indentation at level 4

cl_4_0_0_sql_tree_fix_desc.message: Fields inside a dataType group (level 4) were misaligned relative to the group. Every level now respects the expected indentation step.

cl_4_0_0_sql_history_desc.message: Every entry in the history now shows whether the query succeeded or failed, how many rows it returned and how long it took. Hover to see the error message if any.

cl_4_0_0_sql_export_res_desc.message: From Run → Export results (or Ctrl+Shift+E) you can now pick the format: CSV, JSON or HTML.

cl_4_0_0_logout_observer_title.message: Lower overhead for the session-timeout blocker

cl_4_0_0_logout_observer_desc.message: The module that prevents the session-expiration popup from blocking the page now uses fewer background resources. Visible behaviour is unchanged.

cl_4_0_0_vro_toggle_fix_title.message: Fix: View Record Object switch is now honored

cl_4_0_0_vro_toggle_fix_desc.message: Before, turning off the 'View Record Object' switch in the popup only hid the right-menu entry — the module kept loading in the background. Disabling it now stops the module completely.

cl_4_0_0_settings_iocfg_desc.message: Two new buttons next to Enable/Disable all let you download every preference as a JSON file and restore them on another browser or account in one click.

cl_4_0_0_cmdp_kbd_title.message: Shortcut badges in the Command Palette

cl_4_0_0_cmdp_kbd_desc.message: Actions that have a keyboard shortcut now show it as a pill next to their name, so you can discover it without having to memorise it.

cl_4_0_0_cheatsheet_desc.message: Press Ctrl+Shift+? (or Cmd+Shift+? on Mac) on any NetSuite page and a panel opens with every NSFT shortcut grouped by context.

cl_4_0_0_darkaudit_desc.message: The Load Record Console modal, the Load N Module window and the Advanced PDF Preview panel now follow the system dark theme, matching the rest of NSFT windows.

cl_4_0_0_i18n_desc.message: A handful of buttons and messages that weren't being picked up by the locale files (the Prefix label in settings, Copy HTML / Copy XML, the Edit button in Grouped Tabs, the SQL formatter error toast and the Clear search button) now show up translated.

cl_4_0_0_popup_search_title.message: Popup search with result counter and highlight

cl_4_0_0_popup_search_desc.message: The settings search now shows how many options matched right under the input and highlights the query inside each toggle's title and description in yellow.

cl_4_0_0_clipboard_desc.message: Every copy action in NSFT now also works in iframes and screens where it used to fail silently. A small floating toast shows the text that was copied.

cl_4_0_0_welcome_desc.message: Installing NSFT for the first time now opens a welcome tab listing the extensions you should uninstall to avoid conflicts, plus a quick tour of the main features. Updates don't trigger it.

cl_4_0_0_gotorecord_title.message: Jump to a record with Alt+G

cl_4_0_0_gotorecord_desc.message: New Alt+G shortcut to jump straight to any record without going through Advanced Search. Accepts tranids (INV-00123), types with id (customer 942, invoice 12847) and custom records: type the name or scriptId and suggestions show up as you type; pick one and the existing records appear so you can jump to one directly. With an id it opens the record; without it, the custom record. Also available from the Tools menu.

cl_4_0_0_fieldpreview_desc.message: Hover over a custom field label (custbody_*, custentity_*, custitem_*, custcol_*, custrecord_*) or the record-type / sublist copy icons to get a tooltip with the scriptid, name, type and source list (for List/Record fields). Ctrl+click copies a SuiteScript 2 snippet (record.getValue / getLineCount / record.load), Alt+click copies the SuiteScript 1 equivalent. Shown above the label so the field value stays visible. No more jumping to the field definition just to remember the syntax.

cl_4_0_0_mainmenu_desc.message: Make the top navigation bar (Activities, Lists, Reports…) larger or smaller with one-click presets and a live preview in the popup.

cl_4_0_0_sql_sidebar_polish_desc.message: The Schema Explorer sidebar now matches the rest of the modal's colors in both light and dark mode — no more gray or bluish tint making it look stapled on from another palette. Dragging the resize handle now tracks the cursor instantly, without the lag it used to have.

cl_4_0_0_toast_topright_title.message: Copy notices moved to the top-right corner

cl_4_0_0_toast_topright_desc.message: Whenever NSFT copies something to the clipboard, the floating notice now shows up in the top-right corner and slides in from the right. It leaves a safe margin below the NetSuite nav bar and no longer sits on top of content at the bottom.

cl_4_0_0_perf_lightweight_desc.message: NSFT uses fewer resources when a NetSuite page opens. Features that rely on SuiteQL queries (like "Go to record" and the custom field hover preview) only come online when you actually use them, not on every page. The shared SQL formatting and code highlighting libraries now load once per page instead of multiple times.

cl_4_0_0_envbadge_restore_title.message: PRD/SB/RP badge returns automatically after updates

cl_4_0_0_envbadge_restore_desc.message: After an extension update (or when Chrome restarts the background process) the PRD/SB/RP badge no longer disappears from already-open NetSuite tabs. You used to have to toggle the setting off then on to get it back; now it repaints itself automatically.

cl_4_0_0_sr_user_tab_only_title.message: Scripted Records: User tab shows User Events only

cl_4_0_0_sr_user_tab_only_desc.message: In the Scripted Records modal, the User tab now lists only User Event scripts. It used to dump every other server-side type (Mass Update, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Suitelet, RESTlet, Portlet, Bundle Installation) into that same list, cluttering the view and mixing in scripts that don't fire during the record's lifecycle.

cl_4_0_0_editor_theme_noflash_title.message: Code editor: no more flash on open

cl_4_0_0_editor_theme_noflash_desc.message: When you open a script file, the editor now appears already themed from the start — no more brief flash of the white default editor you used to see. The loading screen also matches how long the page actually takes: on fast opens it goes away almost instantly, and opening another file with the same theme comes up even quicker.

cl_4_0_0_sfv_sublist_title.message: Info ⓘ icon now also on sublist columns

cl_4_0_0_sfv_sublist_desc.message: The field info ⓘ icon now shows on sublist cells when you're editing a line — including columns that are locked read-only (calculated totals, fixed fields, etc.). Hover a cell, click the ⓘ, and from the popup you can see the field's internal ID, its current value, and use the "Disabled" toggle to unlock the column and edit it like any other. The button shows up only on the cell you're pointing at and sits next to the value without covering it.

cl_4_0_0_sql_lint_unknown_title.message: Lint also flags typos in field names

cl_4_0_0_sql_lint_unknown_desc.message: Reference a field that doesn't exist on a known table (a typo, or one chained through a join like t.entity.foo) and the lint now marks it with a dotted orange underline. Hover to see which table it doesn't belong to. The browser's default tooltip that used to layer on top of the custom popup is gone.

cl_4_0_0_sql_builtin_i18n_desc.message: Tooltips for BUILTIN.CF, DF, CURRENCY, CONSOLIDATE, HIERARCHY, PERIOD and the rest now show their description in your language.

cl_4_0_0_sql_sidebar_noflicker_title.message: Fix: Schema Explorer no longer flashes on open

cl_4_0_0_sql_sidebar_noflicker_desc.message: Opening the SuiteQL Runner used to briefly show the Schema sidebar on the wrong side before snapping to its final position. It now appears in place from the first frame.

cl_4_0_0_sql_shortcuts_intl_title.message: Shortcuts that work on every keyboard layout

cl_4_0_0_sql_shortcuts_intl_desc.message: Refresh schema cache, Import / Export queries, and Hide Editor / Hide Results moved from Ctrl+Alt+* to Ctrl+Shift+*. On Spanish and other Latin/European keyboards Ctrl+Alt is AltGr and used to type a character (€, ®, ¼…) instead of firing the shortcut.

cl_4_0_0_native_links_multi_title.message: Fix: multi-select native fields create one link per value

cl_4_0_0_native_links_multi_desc.message: When Subsidiary, Department, Class or Location holds multiple values, the native record link now produces one link per selected value instead of a single broken link with every id concatenated.

cl_4_0_0_sfv_native_list_title.message: Fix: 'Open List' link for native classification fields

cl_4_0_0_sfv_native_list_desc.message: In the Set Field Values popup, the 'Open List' button for Department, Class, Location and Subsidiary now opens the correct NetSuite list instead of an empty / 404 page.

cl_4_0_0_welcome_redwood_title.message: Redwood compatibility notice on the welcome page

cl_4_0_0_welcome_redwood_desc.message: A new notice on the welcome page lets first-time users know that NSFT is built for the classic NetSuite UI and that Redwood isn't officially supported — some features may not behave as expected there.

cl_4_0_0_sql_fav_rename_title.message: Clearer wording in the Favorites menu

cl_4_0_0_sql_fav_rename_desc.message: The 'Save current query as…' menu item now reads 'Add current query to favorites…', which is what the action actually does.

cl_3_0_2_beta_on_title.message: Previously-Beta features now enabled by default

cl_3_0_2_beta_on_desc.message: Modules that used to be in Beta (maxlength counter, multiselect hierarchy, File Cabinet drag & drop, login sandbox indicator, NetSuite version in the header, etc.) are now stable and ship enabled on install or update.

cl_3_0_2_sql_resize_title.message: Fix: Schema Explorer resize when docked right

cl_3_0_2_sql_resize_desc.message: Dragging the splitter with the sidebar on the right resized it in the wrong direction. Now responds correctly on both sides.

cl_3_0_1_defaults_title.message: Hotfix: new features defaulted disabled corrected

cl_3_0_1_defaults_desc.message: When the extension is updated, toggles for new features are now initialized with their correct default values instead of appearing disabled until the popup is opened.

cl_3_0_0_file_cabinet_desc.message: Dedicated tab with every File Cabinet tool: drag & drop, copy path, edit, rename, delete, preview and more.

cl_3_0_0_fc_actions_title.message: Rename and delete from the row

cl_3_0_0_fc_actions_desc.message: Quick actions per file or folder, with a confirmation showing the affected content count when deleting.

cl_3_0_0_folder_link_desc.message: Copies the current folder's direct link to the clipboard right next to its title.

cl_3_0_0_master_switches_desc.message: Global and per-category buttons to turn every toggle on or off at once.

cl_3_0_0_theme_desc.message: Popup restyled with the brand palette (green as primary).

cl_3_0_0_reorg_desc.message: Toggles previously in Beta now live in their real categories; descriptions are shorter and more direct.

cl_3_0_0_all_count_desc.message: The "All" chip now shows the total number of available options.

cl_3_0_0_fields_desc.message: Character counter, multi-select counter, hierarchical multi-select, floating field groups, wider dropdowns and taller textareas.

cl_3_0_0_sublist_desc.message: Line numbers and quick paging with keyboard shortcuts.

cl_3_0_0_login_desc.message: Prominent company logo and name, sandbox indicator, and automatic return to the account.

cl_3_0_0_version_badge_desc.message: Badge with the exact account release version next to the logo.

cl_3_0_0_sql_hints_desc.message: Editor hints now show label, data type and a color-coded icon per field. Supports chained autocomplete (alias.join.field) at any depth.

cl_3_0_0_sql_explorer_desc.message: Collapsible panel with a tree of tables, fields grouped by type and available joins. Configurable left or right from the View menu. Click to insert, right-click for Copy as SELECT / WHERE.

cl_3_0_0_sql_join_desc.message: Assistant that lists available joins for the FROM tables and inserts them as LEFT / INNER / RIGHT JOIN with an auto-generated alias. Remembers your join-type choice.

cl_3_0_0_sql_lint_desc.message: Wavy underline on fields that are unavailable or removed, with the reason on hover. Rich popover on any identifier showing the full field details.

cl_3_0_0_sql_favorites_desc.message: Star a subset of your saved queries. Toggle from the tab, the favorites dropdown or the Open dialog.

cl_3_0_0_sql_import_desc.message: Share your full collection of saved queries as a JSON file from the File menu. Favorite state is preserved on import.

cl_3_0_0_sql_cache_desc.message: Table schemas are cached for 24h and isolated per account and environment (prod, sb1, sb2, etc.). Refresh button re-fetches on demand.

cl_3_0_0_sql_sample_desc.message: Generates a starter SELECT with the most useful fields from any loaded table.

sqlai_hint_sub_chat.message: Ask me anything about this page or your account and I'll find it for you right away. 😊

sqlai_hint_sub.message: Say which data you're after and I'll write the SuiteQL for you.

sqlai_noprov_sub.message: Set up a provider and its API key first to use the assistant.

sqlai_ph_chat.message: Ask about this page or your account…

sqlai_ph_disabled.message: Set up a provider to get started…

sqlai_key_ph_none.message: this provider doesn't need an API key

sqlai_model_empty.message: No models. Add at least one to use this provider.

sqlai_prov_hide.message: Hide this provider from the chat

sqlai_err_model.message: No model set. Set one up in ⚙ Settings.

sqlai_err_key.message: The provider's API key is missing. Set it up in ⚙ Settings.

sqlai_err_maxsteps.message: Reached the step limit ($1) without finishing the answer.

sqlai_err_channel.message: Couldn't reach the extension engine (channel closed). Try again.

sqlai_err_noresp.message: No response from the extension engine.

sqlai_err_perm.message: You need to grant access to the AI provider before you can use it. Send again and accept the permission Chrome asks for.

sqlai_settings_sub.message: Connect a provider and pick the model the chat will use

sqlai_err_ollama_cors.message: Ollama refused the connection (403). For security it only accepts local calls: restart it with OLLAMA_ORIGINS=chrome-extension://* so the extension can reach it.

sqlai_pref_steps_hint.message: Every query it tried and how it went. Off, you only get the final answer.

sqlai_limit_body.message: It used up the $1 allowed without finishing the answer. Continue and it picks up where it left off, keeping what it worked out. The maximum is changed in Settings › Preferences.

sqlai_limit_resuming.message: Picking up where it left off…
