aifaq_a10.message: Three, all managed from the chat's ⚙ Settings ▸ Preferences. 1) Sensitive-data masking (on by default): emails, phone numbers, tax IDs, card numbers and secrets are hidden from query results before they are sent to the AI provider. 2) Read-only mode (on by default): the AI cannot modify anything; if you allow changes, each one shows a dialog with the exact record and fields, and nothing is applied without your confirmation. 3) A token budget per conversation: once reached, the assistant stops instead of spending more.

cl_6_0_0_ai_privacy_title.message: The AI assistant protects your sensitive data

cl_6_0_0_ai_privacy_desc.message: Emails, phone numbers, tax IDs, card numbers and secrets that appear in query results are hidden before being sent to the AI provider. On by default; can be turned off in the assistant settings.

cl_6_0_0_ai_control_title.message: More control and safety in the AI assistant

cl_6_0_0_cred_clear_title.message: Clear saved credentials in one click

cl_6_0_0_cred_clear_desc.message: The GitHub backup and the AI assistant now have a trash button to clear the saved token or API key without emptying the field by hand. The GitHub token can also be shown or hidden with the eye icon.

cl_6_0_0_ai_control_desc.message: New read-only mode (on by default) with a confirmation dialog for any record change, a token budget per conversation, a running counter with estimated cost, and automatic switching to another model when the provider hits its usage limit. In long conversations it also builds on what it already investigated instead of redoing the work.

cl_6_1_0_shortcuts_desc.message: Alt+Shift plus a key opens them straight away: Q the SuiteQL Runner, O the record object, S scripted records, E the saved search export, B the GitHub backup, P page performance, A the AI assistant, N the N module, and 1 and 2 loading the record in the console. All of them can be reassigned from the cheat sheet with Ctrl+Shift+?.

cl_6_1_0_ai_split_title.message: The page chat and the SuiteQL Runner chat are now independent

cl_6_1_0_ai_split_desc.message: With the runner open, launching the assistant from the page menu collapsed or expanded the runner panel instead of opening its own chat. Each one now has its own panel and conversation, and both can be open at the same time.

cl_6_1_0_sql_runvars_title.message: Variables asked for at run time

cl_6_1_0_sql_runvars_desc.message: Every SuiteQL Runner variable can be fixed, asked for on each run, or carry a default value you can override on the spot. Only the ones the query uses are prompted, and the last value is remembered for the session. Variables also get their own toolbar button.

cl_6_1_0_sql_copy_title.message: A button to copy the results

cl_6_1_0_sql_copy_desc.message: Next to Export there is now Copy: it puts the results on the clipboard as CSV, JSON or TSV to paste straight into Excel or Sheets, with no file download. Ctrl+Shift+C works too.

cl_6_1_0_sql_single_table_title.message: Column suggestions without typing the alias

cl_6_1_0_sql_single_table_desc.message: When the query uses a single table, the editor offers its columns straight in the WHERE, the SELECT or the ORDER BY, with no "alias." prefix. They appear on their own from three letters, or instantly with Ctrl+Space.

cl_6_1_0_sql_catalog_exact_title.message: The table search puts the exact match first

cl_6_1_0_sql_catalog_exact_desc.message: Searching "transaction" in the catalog left the "transaction" table buried among the ones containing it, behind a scroll. The exact match now leads the list, followed by those starting with what you type, and the matching part is highlighted. You can also move through the results with the arrow keys and load with Enter.

cl_6_1_0_sql_hints_contains_title.message: Suggestions match any part of the name

cl_6_1_0_sql_hints_contains_desc.message: Typing "id" now offers "entityid" or "tranid", not just names that start with it, and the matching part is highlighted. Names starting with what you type still come first.

cl_6_1_0_sql_erd_single_title.message: Relationship diagram with a single table

cl_6_1_0_sql_erd_single_desc.message: The SuiteQL Runner diagram now opens even when only one table is cached: you see the entity with its fields, and the links show up as soon as you add more tables.

cl_6_1_0_site_link_title.message: Official website link in the popup

cl_6_1_0_site_link_desc.message: Settings → About now has a direct link to netsuitefulltools.com, with the guides, the news and the support page.

cl_6_1_0_sql_filter_icon_title.message: The field search magnifier is visible again in dark

cl_6_1_0_sql_filter_icon_desc.message: In the SuiteQL Runner schema panel, the search icon disappeared with the dark theme. It is back, and with enough contrast.

cl_6_1_0_sql_hints_dark_title.message: Column suggestions now show in dark

cl_6_1_0_sql_hints_dark_desc.message: With dark mode on, the SuiteQL Runner suggestions dropdown appeared in light and glared. It now follows the theme like the rest of the runner.

cl_6_1_0_cmdp_accents_title.message: The Command Palette finds items with or without accents

cl_6_1_0_cmdp_accents_desc.message: Typing "ordenes de compra" now finds "Órdenes de compra", and the other way round. However you type it, accents and capitals no longer get in the way.

cl_6_1_0_sql_restore_title.message: The SuiteQL Runner returns to its place when leaving full screen

cl_6_1_0_sql_restore_desc.message: Restoring it from full screen used to leave it stuck in the top-left corner. Now it comes back centred, or wherever you had left it.

cl_6_1_0_ghb_autolist_title.message: GitHub backup lists your scripts as soon as it opens

cl_6_1_0_ghb_autolist_desc.message: You no longer need the token and repository filled in to see the inventory: opening the panel lists your scripts, and the back-up button turns on once the list is ready and the settings are complete.

cl_6_1_0_ghb_nopwd_title.message: The browser no longer offers to save your GitHub token

cl_6_1_0_ghb_nopwd_desc.message: Typing the token made Chrome treat it as your NetSuite password and offer to store it in its manager. That no longer happens, and the token still shows hidden with the eye button to reveal it.

cl_6_1_0_ghb_optperm_title.message: GitHub access is only requested if you use it

cl_6_1_0_ghb_optperm_desc.message: The extension no longer ships with GitHub access granted up front: Chrome asks for it the first time you run a backup, so anyone who doesn't use that feature never grants it.

cl_6_1_0_ai_level_title.message: The AI Assistant starts at the lowest reasoning level

cl_6_1_0_ai_level_desc.message: If you have never touched the reasoning selector, the assistant now starts at "Minimum": it answers more directly and spends far fewer tokens. You can raise it any time from the chat or its settings, and your choice is remembered.

cl_6_1_0_sql_boot_title.message: The SuiteQL Runner tells you it's opening

cl_6_1_0_sql_boot_desc.message: Opening it now shows the current step and a progress bar, including the cached-table count, instead of a wait that looked frozen. It also responds to your first clicks as soon as the notice disappears.

cl_6_0_0_sql_export_res_title.message: The results Export button now downloads your results, not the query

cl_6_0_0_sql_export_res_desc.message: In the SuiteQL Runner, the Export button on the results bar was downloading the SQL query instead of the results. It now exports the result rows as CSV, Excel, JSON or HTML, as expected.

cl_6_0_0_sql_vars_title.message: Reusable variables in the SuiteQL Runner

cl_6_0_0_sql_vars_desc.message: Define name/value variables and reference them in your queries as {{name}}; they are filled in automatically when you run. Great for reusing an account, subsidiary or date across many queries. Manage them from Edit ▸ Variables.

cl_6_0_0_sql_cache_manage_desc.message: In the Records Catalog the button now tells you whether the table is already saved and lets you remove it or pull it again from the account, plus open the SuiteQL Runner with the query ready. In the Runner's schema panel, each table can be refreshed or removed on its own.

aifaq_intro.message: The SuiteQL Runner AI assistant is **optional** and only talks to **the provider you configure**. Here is, in detail, what is sent, to whom, and how to control it.

aifaq_q1.message: What is the AI assistant and why does the extension request these permissions?

aifaq_a1.message: They are two **optional** features: the **SuiteQL Runner** assistant, which turns natural-language questions into **read-only** SuiteQL queries, and the **page assistant**, which answers in plain text about the record or page you are viewing. The permissions towards AI domains exist only so the extension can call the **provider you configure**; if you configure none, both stay **inert** and talk to no one.

aifaq_q2.message: What data is sent to the AI provider?

aifaq_a2.message: **Page content is never read or transmitted.** When you use the chat, the following goes to your chosen provider: **your message**, schema metadata (**table and field names**), and the **result rows** of the read-only queries the assistant runs to answer you (**100 rows by default**, cells truncated). On top of that, with **Mask sensitive data** (on by default) the emails, phone numbers, tax IDs, card numbers and secrets in those rows are **masked before leaving your browser**: the provider receives •••, not the real value. The SQL in your editor is **only included if you explicitly confirm it** in the chat. To write a query the assistant only needs the schema; real data travels only as result rows when it executes a query, always within those caps. Queries are restricted to **SELECT/WITH**; the assistant **cannot modify anything** unless you enable record changes, and even then **every change requires your confirmation** (see the last question).

aifaq_a3.message: **Only when you invoke it.** Nothing is transmitted until you configure a provider with **your own API key**, open the runner, type a message and **press Send**. There are **no background, automatic or periodic calls**; if you never configure the AI, **nothing is sent at all**.

aifaq_q4.message: Which provider receives my data? Can I restrict it to a single one?

aifaq_a4.message: **Exactly one**: the one you select and configure, using your own API key. If you configure Claude, the chat sends **only to Claude** and nowhere else. Restricting to a single provider is the **default behaviour** — just configure only that one — and data handling is then governed by that **provider's API terms**.

aifaq_q5.message: What is the localhost / 127.0.0.1 access for?

aifaq_a5.message: For **Ollama** and other local OpenAI-compatible servers: models that run **entirely on your own machine**, with zero data leaving it. It is the **most private option**.

aifaq_q6.message: Are my API keys, messages or NetSuite data stored?

aifaq_a6.message: API keys are stored **only in your device's local storage** (never synced, never sent anywhere except as the auth header to the chosen provider). Messages and responses live **in memory only** and are discarded when you start a new chat or close the page. The extension has **no backend server, no analytics and no telemetry**. As a best practice, you can use **temporary API keys** or delete them after each session, either at the provider or from the extension itself.

aifaq_q7.message: Can the extension send data anywhere else?

aifaq_a7.message: **No.** Under Chrome's Manifest V3, **the browser itself blocks** any request to a domain not declared in the manifest: the permission list you see at install time is the **complete set of possible destinations**. MV3 also forbids remotely hosted code, so **the code you install is exactly the code that runs**.

aifaq_a8.message: **Yes.** A **detailed per-version changelog** is available in the popup, and you can **audit the exact code** Chrome installed on your machine — it lives on disk in this folder (replace user, profile and version):

aifaq_a8b.message: You are welcome to review and analyze it **with no restrictions**, so you can confirm for your own security that **nothing is sent** beyond what is described here.

aifaq_a8c.message: You can also browse it comfortably on the extension GitHub, readable and by version:

aifaq_q9.message: Can I restrict the extension's external access?

aifaq_a9.message: **Yes**, at any time and **directly from Chrome**: on the extension's page **you decide which sites it may contact**.

aifaq_outro.message: Prefer not to use AI in your organization? Leave the assistant **unconfigured** (it stays inert) or use the **Ollama** option for a **fully local** setup. Thank you for using the extension.

un_toast_title.message: NetSuite Full Tools updated to v$1

un_hl_1.message: On install, a wizard lets you pick which features you start with.

un_hl_2.message: Every feature shows an animated preview before you turn it on.

un_hl_3.message: The AI Assistant takes less time to answer each question.

un_hl_4.message: In sublists, whatever stays fixed no longer lets the text underneath show through.

un_hl_5.message: The line you are editing and its buttons stay in view when you scroll right.

un_thanks.message: Thanks to everyone who reports bugs and suggests improvements. Write from the envelope ✉ in the popup — and follow each report's progress right there.

cl_5_1_1_update_notice_desc.message: When the extension updates, a small one-time notice now appears with quick access to what's new. It can be turned off from the popup.

cl_5_1_1_sql_redesign_desc.message: Reorganized, polished interface: a clearer grouped toolbar, full-height schema explorer, results search with magnifier, row and time counter, one-click export button, new editor typography and sleeker dividers. The AI assistant gets a compact provider and model picker, plus a five-level reasoning control.

cl_5_1_1_sql_dark_title.message: Refreshed dark theme in the SuiteQL Runner

cl_5_1_1_sql_dark_desc.message: Dark palette redesigned top to bottom: deeper surfaces, better contrast, cleaner buttons and tabs, and the AI assistant blended into the same style.

cl_5_1_1_sql_fullscreen_title.message: Full screen in the SuiteQL Runner

cl_5_1_1_sql_fullscreen_desc.message: New button on the runner's bar to expand it to the whole screen and return to its previous size with one click.

cl_5_1_0_ai_assistant_title.message: AI assistant in the SuiteQL Runner

cl_5_1_0_ai_assistant_desc.message: Tell it what data you need and it writes the SuiteQL, loads it into the editor and runs it. It knows the records and fields in your account — custom ones included — so it can find the tables and relationships it needs on its own. It remembers the conversation: ask for tweaks like "order it by date" without repeating yourself.

cl_5_1_0_ai_providers_desc.message: Works with Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, OpenCode Zen and a local Ollama. Set up several and switch provider or model from the chat itself. Your API key stays in this browser and is never shared.

cl_5_1_0_ai_context_title.message: Build on your query, or start fresh

cl_5_1_0_ai_context_desc.message: If you already have a query written, the assistant asks up front whether to build on it or start from scratch, so it never mixes up what you meant.

cl_5_1_0_ai_prefs_title.message: See what it tried and what it cost

cl_5_1_0_ai_prefs_desc.message: Turn on the work log to see every query it tried and how each one went, show the tokens each answer used, and set how many steps it may take before giving up.

fip_timeout.message: NetSuite is taking too long. Hover again to retry.

cl_5_1_0_rr_instant_desc.message: The recent records panel now opens at once — no more waiting with the list hidden while it loads. It remembers what you visit as you work (even across tabs and after closing the browser) and quietly brings in anything else in the background.

cl_5_1_0_fip_stuck_desc.message: When your account is under heavy load, hovering a field label no longer freezes the page for a moment, and the tooltip no longer gets stuck on "Loading…" for the rest of the session — if NetSuite takes too long it says so, and hovering again simply retries.

cl_5_1_0_profile_tab_title.message: Open your profile in a new tab

cl_5_1_0_profile_tab_desc.message: The Profile button and its Edit profile menu now behave like real links: middle-click or Ctrl+click opens them in a new tab instead of doing nothing.

sqlai_to_editor_title.message: Replaces whatever you have in the editor with this query.

cl_6_2_0_ai_noclobber_title.message: The assistant no longer overwrites your editor query

cl_6_2_0_ai_noclobber_desc.message: When it answered, it used to drop its query into the editor and wipe whatever you had written. It now shows the results without touching anything, and only writes to the editor if you press "Copy to editor".

cl_6_2_0_ai_incremental_title.message: Tweaks to a query no longer rewrite the whole thing

cl_6_2_0_ai_incremental_desc.message: Ask it to add a column or change a filter on what it just gave you, and you now get that same query with the requested change and nothing else. Before it could rewrite it from scratch, with different aliases or column order, even where the rest was already right.

sqlai_copy_title.message: Copies the query to the clipboard.

sqlai_run_title.message: Runs the query and shows the results. Leaves your editor alone.

cl_6_2_0_ai_vars_title.message: The assistant now knows how to use your {{...}} variables

cl_6_2_0_ai_mode_title.message: You choose whether the assistant acts on its own or asks

cl_6_2_0_ai_mode_desc.message: New "Ask before acting" setting. On (the default) it shows you the query and does nothing until you press; off, it drops the query into your editor and runs it right away, for when you want speed.

sqlai_limit_prefs_title.message: Opens Settings › Preferences at "Max steps per query".

sqlai_mode_ask_desc.message: Asks before editing or running the SQL

sqlai_mode_auto_desc.message: Copies to the editor and runs, in one go

cl_6_2_0_sql_hl_title.message: Matches are highlighted when you search the results

cl_6_2_0_sql_hl_desc.message: As you type in the table search box, matching text is marked inside each cell. Before, it filtered the rows but you had to spot for yourself why each one made the cut.

cl_6_2_1_public_title.message: The extension's code is now public

cl_6_2_1_public_desc.message: You can review the code exactly as published on the Store, readable and verified on every release, at github.com/IrodoriCiel/netsuite-full-tools. The link lives in Settings → About and on the official site: no remote code, no data collection — and you no longer have to take that on faith, you can check.

cl_6_2_1_fieldhist_title.message: Field history no longer freezes the page

cl_6_2_1_fieldhist_desc.message: Clicking "View history" on a field's info used to lock the whole page —no scrolling, couldn't even close the tab— until the history arrived, especially on records with many changes. The query now runs in the background and asks only for that field's changes, so it arrives in moments even on records with thousands of changes.

cl_6_2_1_sql_cols_title.message: Columns no longer go missing from the results

cl_6_2_1_ff_copy_title.message: Copying a field ID now confirms like everywhere else

cl_6_2_1_ff_copy_desc.message: In the field finder, copying an ID only swapped the little icon — the "Copied" confirmation you get everywhere else never showed up. Now it does, with the copied ID on show, and if the copy fails you find out instead of being left guessing.

cl_6_2_1_ff_modal_title.message: The field finder now works in the related-fields popup too

cl_6_2_1_ff_modal_desc.message: When you pick a related group in a saved search ("Customer Fields", "Item Fields"…), NetSuite opens a separate window with that entity's fields. It used to be a plain dropdown there; now you get the same finder as in the main list, with its filters and IDs on show, sized to fit that window.

cl_6_2_1_sql_cols_desc.message: If a column came back empty in the first rows —which is what normally happens when you sort with ORDER BY … DESC— the whole column vanished from the table even when there was data further down, and the same went for columns with no values at all. Now every column in your query shows up, and they also appear in the chart and in whatever you export or copy.

cl_6_2_2_sfv_help_title.message: Field help inside the info panel

cl_6_2_2_sfv_help_desc.message: Field help was brought back, and now shows inside the info panel and can be collapsed.

cl_6_2_2_acct_env_title.message: The account switcher tells production and sandboxes apart

cl_6_2_2_acct_env_desc.message: Fixed the account switcher badge, which marked production the same as sandboxes; it now reads PRD, and each sandbox carries its number (SB1, SB2).

cl_6_2_2_sql_null_col_title.message: Results show every column you asked for

cl_6_2_2_sql_null_col_desc.message: Fixed columns with no value in any row disappearing from the SuiteQL Runner results.

cl_6_2_2_open_tab_title.message: Settings can open in a full browser tab

cl_6_2_2_open_tab_desc.message: Added a button to open the settings popup in a new tab, with a better layout.

cl_6_2_2_ai_chat_mode_title.message: The page assistant only shows the controls it uses

cl_6_2_2_ai_chat_mode_desc.message: Removed the interaction mode from the page assistant; it only applies in the SuiteQL Runner assistant.

cl_6_2_2_prettier_dark_desc.message: Fixed the formatting in logs, code fields and the JSON viewers for Suitelets and RESTlets not changing color along with dark mode, and added an “Auto” option.

cl_6_2_2_env_letters_title.message: Choose how much detail the roles-menu badges show

cl_6_2_2_env_letters_desc.message: Added an option to choose whether the roles-menu badges show the sandbox number (PRD, SB1, SB2) or just the environment type (PD, SB, RP).

cl_6_2_2_no_refresh_btn_desc.message: Removed the refresh-page button from the popup footer, replaced by the open-in-a-new-tab one.

cl_6_2_2_fallback_en_title.message: The default language was changed to English

cl_6_2_2_fallback_en_desc.message: Fixed the extension’s default language being Spanish; it is now English.

cl_6_2_2_dark_pick_title.message: Choose how far dark mode goes

cl_6_2_2_dark_pick_desc.message: Added an option to choose whether dark mode applies to all of NetSuite or just the NSFT tools.

cl_6_2_2_dark_scope_title.message: Dark mode respects your Suitelets and PDFs

cl_6_2_2_dark_scope_desc.message: Fixed dark mode applying over your own Suitelets and PDFs; it now only acts on NetSuite forms.

cl_6_2_2_mackeys_title.message: Shortcuts show the keys your Mac actually has

cl_6_2_2_mackeys_desc.message: Fixed shortcuts on Mac, which showed Ctrl; they now use ⌘, ⌥ and ⇧, and the command palette opens with ⌘ too.

cl_6_2_2_sfv_lang_desc.message: Fixed the labels in the field info panel always coming out in Spanish.

cl_6_5_1_fsc_bg_title.message: The fixed column covers what scrolls under it

cl_6_5_1_fsc_bg_desc.message: Fixed the other columns showing through the fixed first column of sublists on Redwood.

cl_6_5_1_fsc_rows_title.message: The line being edited keeps its column

cl_6_5_1_fsc_rows_desc.message: Fixed the line being edited and its buttons scrolling away when moving a sublist right with the fixed column.

cl_6_5_1_ff_words_title.message: The field finder matches whole words

cl_6_5_1_ff_words_desc.message: Fixed the field finder returning unrelated fields, and it now accepts several words in any order.

cl_6_5_0_previews_title.message: See each feature before turning it on

cl_6_5_0_previews_desc.message: Added an animated drawing of every feature, in the setup wizard and in the full-screen popup, so there is no need to guess what each option does.

cl_6_5_0_wfsearch_i18n_title.message: The Workflow Indexer speaks your language

cl_6_5_0_wfsearch_i18n_desc.message: Fixed the Workflow Indexer panel always showing in Spanish instead of following the extension language.

cl_6_5_0_ai_nquery_desc.message: Changed the path the Assistant uses to query data, which now takes less time on each attempt at the same question.

cl_6_5_0_wizard_title.message: Choose what gets enabled on install

cl_6_5_0_wizard_desc.message: Added a setup wizard with four starting points, one to pick feature by feature, also available from the settings.

cl_6_5_0_prettier_sqlguess_title.message: Only real code fields get formatted

cl_6_5_0_prettier_sqlguess_desc.message: Fixed field labels and ordinary text being formatted as code just for starting with a SQL word.

cl_6_5_0_rolef_i18n_title.message: The role finder speaks your language

cl_6_5_0_rolef_i18n_desc.message: Fixed the role finder's caption always showing in Spanish instead of following the extension's language.

cl_6_5_0_fcpath_toast_desc.message: Added a notice showing the copied path when using the copy-path icon in the File Cabinet, which previously copied with no feedback.

cl_6_5_0_fcdel_wording_desc.message: Fixed the wording of the confirmation message when deleting a folder from the File Cabinet.

cl_6_4_2_gt_accountid_title.message: The account ID is accepted the way NetSuite writes it

cl_6_4_2_gt_accountid_desc.message: Fixed the Grouped Tabs settings rejecting an account ID written with an underscore; both forms are now accepted.

cl_6_4_2_fsh_bg_title.message: Sticky headings cover what scrolls under them

cl_6_4_2_fsh_bg_desc.message: Fixed content showing through the sticky sublist header and the sticky field group title on Redwood.

cl_6_4_1_gtr_anypage_title.message: Go to record works outside record pages

cl_6_4_1_gtr_anypage_desc.message: Fixed Go to record finding nothing outside a record page; it now works anywhere when REST web services are enabled.

cl_6_4_1_prettier_ftl_desc.message: Added FreeMarker recognition to record fields, which now appear highlighted and with their copy and download buttons.

cl_6_4_1_gtr_txnnum_title.message: Go to record finds transaction numbers

cl_6_4_1_gtr_txnnum_desc.message: Added search by transaction number in Go to record, on top of the document number.

cl_6_4_1_sql_transport_title.message: Tool lookups no longer freeze the page

cl_6_4_1_sql_transport_desc.message: Changed how tools look up data: they no longer freeze the page and now work on screens where they used to fail.

cl_6_3_0_isp_refresh_title.message: The preview button is now called Refresh

cl_6_3_0_isp_refresh_desc.message: Changed the preview panel's “Preview” button to “Refresh”, and added icons to both of its buttons.

cl_6_3_0_isp_buttons_title.message: The preview buttons show in full

cl_6_3_0_isp_buttons_desc.message: Fixed the bar with Expand and Preview being cut off by the window edge and covered by the resize handle.

cl_6_3_0_sql_method_title.message: Choose how the SuiteQL Runner fetches rows

cl_6_3_0_sql_method_desc.message: Added an option in the Runner preferences to fetch rows over REST —no NetSuite execution limit and no frozen tab— or over N/query —which works on any account and keeps columns with no values at all—, or let it pick based on the account.

cl_6_3_0_sql_allschema_desc.message: Added an option in the SuiteQL Runner table search to download or refresh every table's schema in one go, with progress and a cancel button.

cl_6_3_0_sql_openfast_desc.message: Fixed the Runner loading every stored table on open; it now loads the ones in the query and leaves the rest one click away in the panel.

cl_6_3_0_sql_wipe_title.message: Clear the SuiteQL Runner schema cache

cl_6_3_0_sql_wipe_desc.message: Added a button in the schema panel to delete every stored schema for the account at once.

cl_6_3_0_sql_autoschema_title.message: Decide when the schema gets downloaded

cl_6_3_0_sql_autoschema_desc.message: Added a button in the SuiteQL Runner schema panel to stop downloading each table's schema as you type it into the query.

cl_6_3_0_sql_par_title.message: Choose how many requests the Runner makes at once

cl_6_3_0_sql_par_desc.message: Added an option in the Runner settings to choose how many simultaneous requests the REST download makes, previously always automatic.

cl_6_3_0_sql_many_title.message: Decide what happens when a query returns a lot of rows

cl_6_3_0_sql_many_desc.message: Added to the SuiteQL Runner preferences how many rows trigger the warning and whether to ask, keep going or stop, with an option to remember the answer from the warning itself.

cl_6_3_0_sql_all_title.message: Choose whether the Runner fetches every row

cl_6_3_0_sql_all_desc.message: Added a checkbox in the SuiteQL Runner preferences to fetch every row the query returns, which disables the maximum records setting.

cl_6_3_0_sql_rows_title.message: The Runner fetches every row you ask for

cl_6_3_0_sql_rows_desc.message: Fixed the SuiteQL Runner stopping at 21,000 rows however high the maximum was set, and it now says when it returns fewer rows than there are.

cl_6_3_0_sql_fmt_key_title.message: The SuiteQL Runner shortcuts work anywhere in the modal

cl_6_3_0_sql_fmt_key_desc.message: Fixed the Runner shortcuts —run, save, format, export…— only responding with the cursor inside the editor, and Ctrl+Shift+F opening the field finder instead of formatting.

cl_6_3_0_env_shape_title.message: The production badge matches the shape of the others

cl_6_3_0_env_shape_desc.message: Fixed the production badge in the account switcher showing with a different shape and size from the sandbox ones on the Redwood interface.

cl_6_3_0_env_dup_title.message: Account switcher badges no longer repeat the number

cl_6_3_0_env_dup_desc.message: Fixed the environment number showing twice in the account switcher badges on the Redwood interface.

cl_6_3_0_isp_dark_title.message: The inline preview follows dark mode

cl_6_3_0_isp_dark_desc.message: Fixed the preview panel results staying light with dark mode on.

cl_6_3_0_isp_lang_title.message: The inline preview shows up in any language

cl_6_3_0_isp_lang_desc.message: Fixed the saved-search preview panel only showing up with NetSuite in English; it now appears whatever language the account runs in.

cl_6_3_0_isp_resize_title.message: The preview keeps the height you leave it at

cl_6_3_0_isp_resize_desc.message: Fixed the preview panel carrying on resizing after releasing the mouse.

sql_rows_capped_unknown.message: Fetched $FETCHED$ rows and there are more left.

sql_rows_capped_gov.message: Fetched $FETCHED$ of $TOTAL$ rows: the download stopped by itself to stay within NetSuite execution limits.

sql_slow_no_order.message: This query has no ORDER BY and NetSuite is paging it very slowly. Ordering by an indexed column —ORDER BY id, for instance— usually makes it far faster.
